ACQ0.causal_question: Can the frozen model express frozen canonical semantic objects through a candidate surface such that they parse and recover the same canonical object?
ACQ0.comparator: the other candidates; matched structured English for token cost only
ACQ0.legitimate_negative_threshold: failing these thresholds means the PREREQUISITE failed; it does not refute H1, H2 or H3
ACQ0.primary_endpoint: repaired parse rate AND exact semantic-preservation rate, reported separately
ACQ0.status_reason: no model call made; blocked by REMOTE_SAFETY_BLOCKED and incomplete M1 integration, not by a scientific obstacle
ACQ0.treatment: one of four candidate syntaxes (A v0 labelled-linear, B simplified v1 labelled-linear, C prefix/S-expression, D constrained JSON/graph)

H1.causal_question: Does receiving the problem IN the representation improve answer accuracy relative to English?
H1.comparator: matched structured English; LaTeX; existing formal notation
H1.legitimate_negative_threshold: no improvement once tokens and information are matched
H1.success_threshold: >=+5 percentage points paired, CI excluding zero

H2.causal_question: Does REASONING IN the representation improve the answer, independently of presentation?
H2.legitimate_negative_threshold: forcing a formal derivation degrades performance (cf. Tam et al., EMNLP 2024)
H2.primary_endpoint: paired answer accuracy; secondarily structural-error rate
H2.success_threshold: >=+5 points answer accuracy OR >=30% structural-error reduction

H3.causal_question: Does verifier feedback change the reasoning trajectory enough to improve the verified answer?
H3.legitimate_negative_threshold: feedback changes only the surface, not the trajectory
H3.reporting_rule: A win on H3 ALONE is a win for verifier-guided reasoning, NOT for the representation.
structural_threats: answer leakage: a diagnostic carrying the target program, final answer or unrestricted patch makes H3 a tautology
no diagnostic at all: where the compiler accepts wrong code the repair loop has nothing to act on (confirmed 2026-08-05: user def calls check neither arity nor argument type)
H3.treatment: same input and derivation, plus diagnostic feedback and one repair

rules: ACQ0 is a prerequisite experiment, not evidence for H1, H2 or H3.
Compiler-assisted syntax repair during ACQ0 is ACQ0_REPAIR, not H3.
H3 requires a mathematical reasoning endpoint and holds the reasoning representation constant.
No aggregate Hamiltonian score may combine H1, H2 and H3.
Every episode, result row, evidence package and report carries exactly one hypothesis_id.
A controller gate may consume evidence only from the hypothesis or prerequisite it names.
Null, positive and negative results are preserved separately.
No earlier conclusion is rewritten silently; corrections are appended and dated.
